welcome: Welcome to Snack Math! These are adding stories, where we bring snacks together. Choose a picnic game.
guided-intro: Listen to the story. Then tap the new snacks to add them to the tray.
counter-intro: Tap each new snack to add it to the tray. Then choose how many there are altogether.
picnic-intro: Make your own picnic. Choose a snack, then tap either side of the tray.
stage-hint: Tap the new snacks to bring them to the tray.
counter-hint: Tap each waiting snack, one at a time.
how-many: How many snacks are there altogether?
picnic-empty: Choose a snack, then tap either side of the tray.
picnic-full: Your tray is full. Tap a snack on the tray to make room.
complete-guided: You solved every snack story. What a wonderful addition picnic!
complete-counter: You counted every snack. Your addition picnic is complete!
berry-1-prompt: Two blackberry friends are waiting on the tray. One raspberry rolls in to join them. How many berry friends are there altogether?
berry-1-success: Two plus one equals three. Three berry friends!
